en.help_tooltip:
c_n's merchants will gather supplies over each timeskip and during any patrols they are sent on. You can see what was gathered in the Log below! The merchants will give these to any hurt or sick scavengers that need them, helping those scavengers to heal quicker.

Hover your mouse over the treasury image to see what supplies your Tribe has!
